modules.PURPOSE: Published fully verified immutable approval generation
modules.PARENT: SUPERVISOR retained birth-anchor; HOST_PLATFORM independently witnesses exact child/parent before enrollment
modules.START_AUTHORITY: HOST_PLATFORM pre-enrollment fixed bootstrap plan only; no operational spawn/exec API

INPUT_ABI.body: Only the declared context/digests, never SQL/shell/command/path/PID/operation-selector payload
INPUT_ABI.challenge_binding: Challenge key=(qualification,epoch,slot,generation,challenge_id,work_id); input digest and expected result schema precommitted by HEALTH_GUARD; nonce only uniqueness, never identity
INPUT_ABI.currentness: Exact trusted generation/enrollment/credential/channel/context and expected generation-registry revision; work_entity_revision is participant-specific CAS predecessor, not a shared global work counter
INPUT_ABI.outcome: Response OBSERVED_EXACT_WORK accepted only with independently observed role result and exact result_digest; self signature alone never counts
INPUT_ABI.replay: Repeated identical request returns original retained terminal receipt without work, new signing, counter advance or expiry renewal; conflicting digest/consumed challenge/stale generation denies; UNKNOWN never retries work

OUTPUT_ABI.body: Only the declared context/digests, never SQL/shell/command/path/PID/operation-selector payload
OUTPUT_ABI.challenge_binding: Challenge key=(qualification,epoch,slot,generation,challenge_id,work_id); input digest and expected result schema precommitted by HEALTH_GUARD; nonce only uniqueness, never identity
OUTPUT_ABI.currentness: Exact trusted generation/enrollment/credential/channel/context and expected generation-registry revision; work_entity_revision is participant-specific CAS predecessor, not a shared global work counter
OUTPUT_ABI.outcome: Response OBSERVED_EXACT_WORK accepted only with independently observed role result and exact result_digest; self signature alone never counts
OUTPUT_ABI.replay: Repeated identical request returns original retained terminal receipt without work, new signing, counter advance or expiry renewal; conflicting digest/consumed challenge/stale generation denies; UNKNOWN never retries work

modules.FIELD_TYPES: Exact per-field type/length in INPUT_ABI; no additional fields
modules.FIELD_LENGTHS: Exact per-field widths; UTF8 1..255; whole frame<=1048576
modules.NULLABILITY: No field nullable; non-result uses explicit NOT_A_RESULT enum and fixed no-result digest, never absent design

CANONICAL_ENCODING.header: magic8 || version u16be || message_type u16be || sender_actor u16be || recipient_actor u16be || payload_length u32be
CANONICAL_ENCODING.payload: field_count u16be; ascending contiguous fields: tag u16be || length u32be || exact typed value; no presence byte because every field is required/non-null
CANONICAL_ENCODING.signature: 64-byte Ed25519 signature over ASCII FLOOOW/PACKAGE0090/R5N/TEST/V1 followed by complete header+payload; fixed algorithm; expected key looked up by enrolled role/purpose/generation, never selected by caller credential_ref
CANONICAL_ENCODING.integers: Unsigned fixed-width big-endian u16/u32/u64; signed i64 is exactly8-byte big-endian two-complement in range -2^63..2^63-1. Overflow/range violation rejects; sequence/generation/revisions checked before increment
CANONICAL_ENCODING.text: Strict UTF8 NFC already normalized, no control/NUL/empty; reject rather than normalize
CANONICAL_ENCODING.bytes: bytes32 and bytes64 exact raw length
CANONICAL_ENCODING.arrays: u32be count then u32be element length and exact canonical typed element; sets sort full unsigned bytes and reject duplicates; bounded <=4096 entries
CANONICAL_ENCODING.unknown: Unknown version/type/field, missing/extra/duplicate/out-of-order tag, invalid width, truncation/MSG_TRUNC/MSG_CTRUNC, trailing bytes or excess ancillary => reject before work
CANONICAL_ENCODING.nonresult: Challenge result_code=0 NOT_A_RESULT and result_digest=SHA256(ASCII FLOOOW/R5N/NO-RESULT/V1); never an observed outcome
CANONICAL_ENCODING.time: Original CLOCK_BOOTTIME microseconds=floor(clock_gettime(CLOCK_BOOTTIME) nanoseconds/1000) in same boot_id/time namespace. server_start_epoch_us is signed finite PostgreSQL microseconds since2000-01-01T00:00:00Z, matching frozen PgStartTime/pg_stat_activity conversion, not Unix1970; reject PostgreSQL infinity sentinels. Approval signed-window wall time preserves original canonical UTC encoding and authoritative independently observed database clock; never compare it directly to BOOTTIME. Immutable policy gives finite positive max age, work deadline, key validity and heartbeat frame limits; numeric values remain independently approved provisioning data; time/nonce never authority
CANONICAL_ENCODING.schema_JSON: For expected_result_schema_digest only: exact declared field-schema array with object keys sorted ASCII lexicographically, arrays in declared order, UTF8 bytes, no BOM/newline/whitespace. Allowed values are printable ASCII strings, booleans true/false and exact nonnegative integers<=9007199254740991; no null/float/nonfinite/negative/duplicate keys. Decimal integers no leading zeros; strings escape only quote and backslash, slash is unescaped. This restricted domain is exactly json.dumps(schema,sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False).encode(UTF8) for these schema objects. SHA256 those exact bytes; schema digest is design data, never binary identity

modules.CONTEXT_BINDING: All ordered ABI subject/emitter fields and exact typed input/result record, including expected original public material, policy, manifest and binding fingerprint
modules.GENERATION_BINDING: Exact current incarnation+slot+generation+enrollment; latest high-water never falls back
modules.REGISTRY_REVISION_BINDING: Frozen current generation registry revision plus current participant work entity predecessor; both rechecked before CAS/guard
modules.CHALLENGE_BINDING: HEALTH_GUARD-authenticated one-use challenge and work ID; expected input/result schema precommitted
modules.COMPLETED_WORK_BINDING: completed-work-protocol.json exact participant rule, independent witness required
modules.CREDENTIAL_TYPE: TEST-only slot/generation/purpose Ed25519 transport certificate plus one-use work authorization; original canonical SPKI verify-only
modules.CREDENTIAL_SOURCE: HOST_PLATFORM approved private TEST key custody; CSPRNG at future provisioning, no provider/domain/execution secret reuse
modules.CREDENTIAL_CUSTODY: Only exact process UID, sealed memfd4 then private non-dumpable memory; no shared signing API/FD transfer; zero private key returns/logs; expected public ref pinned independently
modules.CREDENTIAL_USE_COUNT: At most one accepted work completion per signed work authorization; duplicate requests return same retained receipt, no second signature/effect. Heartbeat key purpose restricted and bounded by approved per-generation frame limit
modules.CREDENTIAL_EXPIRY_RULE: Current generation/enrollment plus immutable approved native policy key-valid-until BOOTTIME in exact boot/timens; expiry/revoke/tombstone invalidates without renewal; no hardcoded experimental TTL
modules.CHANNEL_TYPE: Inherited AF_UNIX SOCK_SEQPACKET fd5; no alternate socket/path/RPC endpoint
modules.CHANNEL_AUTHENTICATION: Creation inventory binds socketpair cookies/inodes, creator anchor and intended peer roles. SO_PEERPIDFD on inherited socket proves creation peer only. Each recvmsg requires exactly one current kernel SCM_PIDFD matching enrolled sender; no post-start SCM_RIGHTS/duplicate descriptors allowed
modules.PEER_IDENTITY_RULE: Signed bootstrap inventory creator identity + kernel CURRENT sender anchor + exact enum/credential/context equality
modules.REPLAY_REJECTION: Repeated identical request returns original retained terminal receipt without work, new signing, counter advance or expiry renewal; conflicting digest/consumed challenge/stale generation denies; UNKNOWN never retries work
modules.STALE_GENERATION_REJECTION: Exact latest authoritative current slot generation; old signed receipts cannot restore it
modules.WRONG_PARENT_REJECTION: Compare retained expected parent tuple, no name/PID-only match
modules.WRONG_BINARY_REJECTION: Compare approved executable+module+loader+dependency manifest actual measured identity before enrollment/publication
modules.WRONG_CONTEXT_REJECTION: Reject any mismatch in fixed expected ABI tuple, including original signed bundle/custody
modules.UNKNOWN_BEHAVIOR: Persist exact pending work/operation tuple and quarantine; no blind retry/replacement/eligibility
modules.REVOCATION_BEHAVIOR: Irreversible generation/credential/channel ineligibility and tombstone; keep retained evidence until independent extinction
modules.CRASH_BEHAVIOR: Crash/ACK loss yields UNKNOWN unless independent exact outcome already durable; never treat process death as abort/extinction
modules.OUTPUT_WITNESS: HEALTH_GUARD independent result check; ENFORCEMENT_WORKER additionally requires CENSUS_OBSERVER actual outcome, not worker signature
modules.INDEPENDENT_OBSERVER: HEALTH_GUARD observed by HOST_PLATFORM; producer verification separately repeated by APPROVAL_CONSUMER

original_approval: Producer and consumer repeat frozen _observer_once public-material verification: exact independent custody status/bundle, SPKI DER/fingerprint, canonical manifest hash, exact canonical signature preimage and original Ed25519 signature, current signed window and independently fetched exact header/lifecycle. TEST transport signatures never replace original approval evidence
native_enforcement: Only one prebound target fd6 and fixed STOP_THEN_TERM_THEN_CONT; no PID, signal, path, SQL or shell selector; lost syscall/commit result UNKNOWN and never reexecuted
